title: Chapter 1448 - 2: Don'T Go! Absolutely Don'T Go!!!
content:
Chapter 1448 - 2: Don'T Go! Absolutely Don'T Go!!!

Chapter 1448 - 2: Don't Go! Absolutely Don't Go!!!

"The mighty Legendary Lord, how could he fall into such madness?"

Lin Yuan had long known from the owner of the Time-Space Shop that the Dragon Stone Lord was in a peculiar condition, influenced by ancient times.

But it was still somewhat unexpected.

The Dragon Stone Lord was not only mad but had completely considered himself the 'Returning Ruins Lord'?

He couldn't even maintain his own self.

It can be imagined, if the Returning Ruins Lord hadn't completely fallen.

It's estimated that with a single thought, he could allow the Dragon Stone Lord to become a vessel for descent.

"Returning Ruins Lord?"

Some information about this Legendary Lord appeared in Lin Yuan's mind.

Not much information related to the Returning Ruins Lord has been passed down, only that this Legendary Lord was unimaginably powerful, having reached the final stage of the transcendence path, already past the third billion tribulation.

It's important to know, the last stage of tribulations amounts to thirty-three hundred tribulations, the third billion? And the Dragon Stone Lord even mentioned the third billion and one thousandth tribulation? Indeed, it was near the end of the transcendence path.

The Lord Wanwei, who opened up the Wanwei time-space, had only passed the two hundred millionth tribulation in the final stage.

"Such a powerful Legendary Lord, did he also die in the end? Died in the subsequent tribulations?"

Lin Yuan thought quietly.

Although he didn't know the specific strength of the Returning Ruins Lord, just the remnants of his thoughts, separated by endless ages and different time-spaces, made the Dragon Stone Lord lose himself and fall into madness, showing how terrifying it was.

As the Dragon Stone Lord returned to the Gold Moon dimension, the owner of the Time-Space Shop looked at Lin Yuan rather helplessly: "It seems we'll have to wait a while, until the Dragon Stone Lord regains a little clarity before trading."

The Dragon Stone Lord, under the influence of the 'Returning Ruins Lord' remnants, occasionally becomes clear-headed. When he's clear-headed, the Dragon Stone Lord is basically a normal lord, unlike his current incomprehensible state.

"I had long warned Dragon Stone to be cautious when exploring ancient times..."

The owner of the Time-Space Shop shook his head. He had known the Dragon Stone Lord for a long time, and they had many transactions in the long bygone years.

In fact, the owner of the Time-Space Shop had a wide network, at least being quite famous within the circle of second-tier lords.

Without delving too far, just the past, present, and future of the Chaos Void alone were under Lin Yuan's gaze. If other lords dared to explore the past of the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan could suppress them with the power of the entire Chaos Void with just a thought.

Otherwise, he wouldn't have dared to tell Lin Yuan earlier that invoking his name could be a lifesaver when encountering danger in the Wanwei time-space.

"The ancient times were indeed dangerous."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Without delving too far, just the past, present, and future of the Chaos Void alone were under Lin Yuan's gaze. If other lords dared to explore the past of the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan could suppress them with the power of the entire Chaos Void with just a thought.

"When will the Dragon Stone Lord probably regain clarity?"

Lin Yuan asked.

The first tribulation of the 'endless tribulations' has no time limit, but Lin Yuan still wanted to know how long it might take.

"At least a hundred billion years, at most a few cycles of great collapse should suffice," the owner of the Time-Space Shop estimated slightly.

For a lord, a few cycles of great collapse are not considered long.

"A hundred billion years? A few cycles of great collapse?"

Lin Yuan furrowed his brows.

Talking about a few cycles of great collapse.

Even just a hundred billion years, Lin Yuan couldn't accept.

"What's wrong? Is it urgent?"

The owner of the Time-Space Shop noticed the change in Lin Yuan's expression.

"That's quite long."

Lin Yuan nodded, thought for a while, then said: "If I can awaken the Dragon Stone Lord earlier, can we then trade normally?"

With those words.

The owner of the Time-Space Shop almost thought he heard wrong.

To awaken the Dragon Stone Lord earlier?

If that's truly the premise, a normal trade was indeed possible.

But what method could free the Dragon Stone Lord from the 'Returning Ruins Lord' influence and awaken him earlier?

The owner of the Time-Space Shop looked at Lin Yuan. If not for the tens of thousands of years they've known each other, seeing that Lin Yuan wouldn't speak without confidence, he almost thought Lin Yuan was talking nonsense.

"How do you plan to awaken the Dragon Stone earlier?"

The owner of the Time-Space Shop steadied himself, still intending to listen to Lin Yuan's method.

"If you need my help, or perhaps from other lords, just say so....."

The owner of the Time-Space Shop added.

"No need to trouble yourself that much."

Lin Yuan shook his head, gaze fixed on the distant Gold Moon dimension.

Through the Dragon Stone Lord's state just now, and the connection with the Gold Moon dimension.

There would be no need to meet the Dragon Stone Lord face-to-face just to ascertain.

"No need to trouble yourself that much?"

Lin Yuan had already concluded that the Dragon Stone Lord's control over the Gold Moon dimension was far from reaching a complete refining standard.

Even less possible was the idea to obliterate this dimension space with a single thought.

In fact, if not for the 'Returning Ruins Lord' remnants' pollution on the Dragon Stone Lord, Lin Yuan viewing forward on the timeline would be excessively obscure and twisted.

There would be no need to meet the Dragon Stone Lord face-to-face just to ascertain.

"No need to trouble yourself that much?"

The owner of the Time-Space Shop showed a puzzled look.

However, in the next moment.

The owner of the Time-Space Shop's eyes widened in shock.

Lin Yuan had his gaze fixed on the Gold Moon dimension.

Suddenly extended his hand.

Woosh—

His hand, like the heavens collapsing, covering the cosmos, directly reached into the Gold Moon dimension.

As a top-level dimension space, the Gold Moon dimension, though not repelling external temporal beings, naturally was heavily shrouded in restrictions being the Dragon Stone Lord's domain.

However, under this hand, the forces outside the Gold Moon dimension rapidly crumbled. This hand caused no damage to the Gold Moon dimension, but directly penetrated its depths.

Then gently gripped.

Buzz— slight struggling ripples came, but instantly subsided.

Immediately after.

Lin Yuan's extended right hand retracted, withdrawing from the Gold Moon dimension's depths.

Compared to the time when it ventured in, now Lin Yuan's hand was no longer empty, but instead held a fine shadow.
